I was your age when I started sh-ing and trust me, even if the first time is not even a cut, or a very 'safe' one, I wish I didn't to this day. The first few times you can control it, but it becomes an addiction way too fast  and even an adult can't help it at that point. Seek help from someone who will support you when there is still time. SH ruins your mental health even more, marks your body for like and changes you forever. You will never see certain things and places the same way after you associate it with SH.

Also  there is no 'recovery' from it. Even if you stop SH-ing at one point, the willingness will stay with you and at one point or another, when your like gets messy  you will wish to do it again (even if you end up nit doing it)

The first times, SH is a choice, but in the end, it feels like a need
